findings.title: The phone layout does not fit the screen

location.description: the whole page at phone width

findings.viewer_experience: A phone visitor sees a broken page and has to pan sideways to find the search form.

current.value: page 587 px wide in a 390 px viewport; lead 9.1 characters per line over 18 lines

findings.target: page no wider than the viewport, in one column (headline, lead, form, routes), with the navigation folded into a compact phone pattern
findings.fix_direction: At phone width, put everything in one column (headline, lead, form, routes) and fold the navigation into the usual compact pattern for a phone.

closed_when.check: page_width in the phone viewport is 390 or less, and characters_per_line of p.lead in the phone viewport is 30 or more

findings.title: The headline is the weakest text on the page and the reason to book here is buried
findings.viewer_experience: The paragraph and the button outweigh the heading, and the book-direct, no-fee point sits in the second and third sentences of the paragraph.

current.value: 22 px, weight 400, #6b7574, below the 20 px lead in dark #26302f

findings.target: the headline is the largest and darkest text on the page, with a real step up from the lead, in the body color, and carries the book-direct, no-fee point
findings.fix_direction: Make the headline clearly the largest and darkest thing on the page, with a real step up from the lead. Put the book-direct, no-fee point in it or right under it, and darken the h1 to the body color. A week's hire price or the agency fee the visitor avoids would help, but that figure must come from the maker; the maker must supply it.
findings.source: Bringhurst 3.1.1; Dair, Design with Type, ch. 8-9

closed_when.check: font_size of h1 in all viewports is larger than that of p.lead, and color of h1 is the body color #26302f

findings.title: Two buttons do one job, and the wrong one is primary

location.description: the outlined Search button at the bottom of the form

findings.viewer_experience: A visitor who fills in the form reaches a weaker button than the one they skipped, and cannot tell whether "See boats and dates" uses their choices.

current.value: "See boats and dates" is filled dark green; "Search" is outlined

findings.target: "Search" is the one filled primary button; the hero button is removed or has a clearly different job
findings.fix_direction: Make "Search" the one filled primary button. Remove the hero button, or give it a clearly different job.
findings.source: Material 3 and Apple HIG emphasis levels; Nielsen 8

closed_when.check: In the new image of all viewports, "Search" is the one filled primary button and no second filled button competes with it for the same job.

findings.title: A holiday on the water with nothing to look at

location.description: the empty area under the hero button

findings.viewer_experience: The visitor gets no feeling of the trip they are booking; the copy has to carry the whole sale.

current.value: no boat, lock or canal shown in any viewport

findings.target: one specific image of this company's boats or routes fills the empty area under the button without pushing the form down
findings.fix_direction: Add one specific image of this company's boats or routes, not a stock scene, placed so it fills the empty area under the button rather than pushing the form down. The maker must supply the image.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees one specific image of the company's boats or routes in the empty area under the button, and the form has not moved down.

findings.title: On wide screens the page splits in two, with empty space between

location.description: the empty area between the hero button and the routes list

findings.viewer_experience: The eye jumps across empty space, the page reads as two unrelated halves, and the routes that depend on the Base select sit far from it.

current.value: empty area between button bottom 338 and routes list 612; on widescreen the form sits at x 1516, about 850 px from the text column

findings.target: content held in one width cap so the form stays near the text, with the routes pulled into the empty space or placed where the link to the Base field is visible
findings.fix_direction: Keep the content in one width cap so the form stays near the text. Pull the routes up into the empty space, or place them where the connection to the Base field is visible.
findings.source: Arnheim, on balance; Norman, natural mapping

closed_when.check: In the new desktop and widescreen images, the form sits near the text column, no large empty area separates the button from the routes, and the routes sit where their link to the Base field is visible.

findings.title: The h1 and the gray route figures are just under 4.5:1 contrast

location.description: the h1 and the route figures such as "7 nights, 38 locks"

findings.viewer_experience: The gray text is slightly too faint for low-vision readers.

closed_when.check: contrast of h1 and of ul > li > span:nth-of-type(2) in all viewports is 4.5 or more

findings.title: On the phone the route figures split numbers from their units and the route names wrap

location.description: the route figures in the routes list

findings.viewer_experience: Figures such as "12 / locks" and "61 / locks" break across two lines.
findings.fix_direction: Keep each figure on one line, which the one-column layout should give it room for.

closed_when.check: lines of ul > li > span:nth-of-type(2) in the phone viewport is 1

findings.title: On the tablet the lead runs in a narrow column and ends with a single word
findings.viewer_experience: The lead is cut into short lines and ends with "hire." alone on the last line.
findings.target: a wider text column, or the form stacked under the text, with no single word on the last line
findings.fix_direction: Give the text column more width, or stack the form under it.

closed_when.check: characters_per_line of p.lead in the tablet viewport is 40 or more, and the last line of p.lead is not one word in the new tablet image

findings.title: The select and input borders look pale and may be below 3:1

location.description: the borders of the select and input fields in the search form

findings.viewer_experience: Pale gray borders on white make the fields hard to see.

current.value: pale gray on white, not measured

findings.target: border contrast of at least 3:1 against the white card
findings.fix_direction: Measure the border color and darken it if it fails.

closed_when.check: In the new image of all viewports, the form field borders are clearly visible against the white card, and their measured contrast is 3:1 or more.

findings.title: The start date field shows no year and looks like a plain text field

location.description: the start date input showing "Sat 14 June"

findings.viewer_experience: Near the end of a year a visitor cannot tell which June they are booking.
findings.target: the year is shown, or it is clear that a date picker sets the value
findings.fix_direction: Show the year, or make it clear that a date picker sets the value.

closed_when.check: In the new image of all viewports, the start date field shows the year or clearly signals a date picker.
